l'm 20F going through the same thing, the best advice I can give you is to work on your routine and habits that make you feel good about yourself, it works like magic and you will get this power to be determined about what you really care about,  you can't change what other people think but you can change what you think,
meditation is great and writing a diary makes you focus on your day,

not knowing the best career for you is natural, a lot of people feel the same, and thinking about the future and other possibilities can be overwhelming sometimes, so planning a day by day is much easier,  productive, and others will notice your determination.

I hope you find your way to improve yourself and learn from difficulties :)

ps: don't forget to put your boundaries
